remarks:
This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2-bath two-story home offers 2,022 square feet of living space on a generous 0.55-acre lot in the City of Olean.

The versatile floor plan includes a first-floor bedroom and full bath, ideal for guests, multi-generational living, or a dedicated home office. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms, a full bath with convenient laundry, and a spacious flex room that can easily serve as a second family room, playroom, office, study area, or reading nook.

The main level features a spacious living room, a dedicated dining room, and a separate breakfast nook, providing comfortable spaces for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen provides ample cabinet and workspace, featuring soft-close cabinetry and drawers. A corner dining set in the breakfast nook is included with the sale. Just off the kitchen, you'll find easy access to the expansive composite deck.

Outdoor living is a standout feature of this home. The deck surrounds the above-ground pool, creating the perfect space for relaxing on warm summer days. Beyond the deck, the large, level backyard offers plenty of room for gardening, pets, outdoor games, or simply enjoying the open space. A detached two-car garage provides additional storage and parking. For added peace of mind, the hot water tank was replaced in July 2026.

With its versatile floor plan, inviting indoor and outdoor living spaces, and convenient City of Olean location, this move-in-ready home is ready to welcome its next owners.
